'''Levi Schoen''' was an [[Gender/Legends|androgyne]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She [[Actor/Legends|played]] a popular character named "[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jesrella]]" and while filming Jesrella's coronation, Schoen was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Melo Centris]], who stabbed her in the back with a [[Knife/Legends|knife]].
